title: The Other Future
subtitle: Everyone has the right to choose their future, right?

trails.title: Unexpected Audience
trails.description: George the Oak is already 700 years old. Which animals in the tree hole listened to that song with you?

items.text: The Other Future

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Years after, when I think of that escape ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Still feels like I was in a chess game, playing against an invisible enemy.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Back then, I knew nothing about chess, nor resigning, let alone the fact I was in the zugzwang.
On the night of the 27th

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's impossible to go to the clinic through the girls' dorm. The clinic is now crowded with people, and we must give up the road to the southeast watchtower.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We have another option: to go to the classroom first, then enter the air-raid tunnel from the library.

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: That is to say, we are heading to the northwest tower?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Exactly. Once we get down to the tunnel, we will be much safer. Have you left the window open on the first floor?

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: Yes, don't worry. I didn't lock it ... Or I can take you in from the library's front door, if the window were to be locked by the caretaker.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The most dangerous part is from the dorm to the library. Not only will we pass the classroom, but also be exposed under the surveillance of the central watchtower.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Leave that with me! I will cut the fuse in the central watchtower, and that should give you a five-minute blackout.

items.speaker: Student C
items.text: And you gotta watch out for the patrol team! I will drive them away from you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ok. Now split up. Once the central watchtower's lights is out, we move. I will see you under the A12 window of the library.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And these crystal earrings are gifts from Matilda before I left.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wear these and we can hear each other within a certain distance.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: That's all. Be careful. I will see you soon!

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: This is The Ring. En route to the central tower. No visible personnel. All clear.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Copy. Be careful. Keep in touch.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Hmm? The thing ahead is ...

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: ... Damn it! It's the patrol team.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: People in the classroom, distract them.

items.speaker: Student C
items.text: Roger that!

items.speaker: Patroller
items.text: It'll be the curfew soon. What are you doing here?

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: I ... I had an upset stomach and was trying to walk it off. Sorry, sir, I'm heading back to the dorm now.

items.speaker: Patroller
items.text: Stop. Show me your ID.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Ba4. Cut off the power for the central watchtower for five minutes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ...! Fuse box tripped?! Now is the time! Go!

items.speaker: Student C
items.text: Sir, sir ...! The light is out in the central tower. Please come take a look! Is it gonna be problematic?

items.speaker: Patroller
items.text: What ... We are going back.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Everyone, go to the library now!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's difficult to sneak out of the dorm at this time ... Isabella, if we get stopped by the supervisor, be prepared for conflict.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Bb3. Are the flower bouquets for the dorm supervisor in position? There're also quite a number of gifts in them.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Heads down, stay low ... Don't get caught ... hm?

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: How come there're so many visitors at the supervisor's office ... They won't see us getting by.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Great. Go!

items.speaker: Student B
items.text: How long until you get here? I'm already at the back of the library.

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: Is the window still open at A12? The caretakers didn't notice it, did they?

items.speaker: Student B
items.text: Yeah, but ... window A12 is a small one! Only little girls like you can get in!

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: Ah ... How come ...

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: I chose it for it's hidden in the corner ... This is awful ...

items.speaker: Student B
items.text: It's ok, don't worry! Ha ...! I'm in! A11 is not locked either!

items.speaker: Student B
items.text: You can get in through A11 too!

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: 0-0. The windows were all left opened, just in case.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The caretaker would of course be careless at work, given the inspection was just over.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: What's your move then, Vertin? To boldly push forward or ... start to feel skeptical?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Amazing, everything is going so well today. You keep watching. We will be right there!

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Heh-heh ...
The top level of the central tower smells like alcohol.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The black-out watchtower, curtained-up classroom windows, blind patrol teams ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Ha ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: What a well-planned malpractice show.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: No wonder ... burp! Giving me this fine vodka is just ... a trade for my dizzy head and half-shut eyes.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Burp ... look who's after those kids! Hopefully I'm not too drunk to get it wrong ... Is that the good student?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hahaha ...! Interesting. Your flying ace, reporting for duty!
She pulls out a crumpled map from her pocket and takes a few mouthfuls from the bottle.
A red shadow, flying low, heads towards the library.
Air-raid Tunnel

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: According to the map, we are now out of the library. Keep going, everyone!

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: What, what is that noise ...? It's scary.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: We should be under the sports field now. Probably some big shot is having some fun with his levitating car ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, it's thunder.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's about to rain.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Everything goes so well today ... too well maybe, making me uneasy.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Don't think like that. Look! We are entering the northwest tower after this crossing.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Who knows what will be there waiting for us. Let's ...

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: Arrgh!!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What's wrong!

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: Person, a person ... sits at the intersection.
The person walks out under the light, wobbly.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Finally? My patience is running out.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You are ... air force from Zeno! What are you doing here?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Being dedicated to duty ... burp! And catch you guys!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: You really think escaping can be so easy?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: She is a soldier with field experience. If we can't take advantage within the first few rounds ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You guys retreat immediately, and I'll cover for you. As long as one of us can get out of school, our plan succeeds.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Oh? I can hear you.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: In that case, I have to be extra careful, in case any of you lab rats runs away.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Please be mindful of your language, Lilya!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Your duty is to eliminate the Olitiaus in the campus, not attacking the students!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ...! Sonetto! Why are you here ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: She walks up to Vertin and yet doesn't respond to her question. She pulls out her wand and stands before Lilya.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: ... Haha, seriously? Is malpractice a compulsory course in your Foundation?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Then try me ... Let me see the best you got!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Stono Swift!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Okay. She's now temporarily paralyzed.
She places Lilya against the wall and falls silent.
There are still so many mysteries.
When did she start to follow? What are her plans and thoughts ...
But there is not much time left.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We're leaving, Sonetto.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you for your assistance. Goodbye.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... You're going to do something very dangerous, aren't you?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Even if ... it will cost you everything you've had here ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You will not be regretful, right?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We have prepared for everything that could happen. No regrets.
Sonetto looks at the students' faces and tightly holds her wand in her hand.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Seems like you ... won't be needing my notebook anymore.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We chose a different future.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But future has no right or wrong, Sonetto.
The Ring pulls down the switch of the blast door.
A stone wall is slowly put down before Sonetto.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Go back. Get yourself out of these things.
Her face gradually disappears on the other side of the door.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... It was a pleasure to be your deskmate, Vertin.
TO BE CONTINUED…
